pundit.name: Alexi Lalas
pundit.take: **Devin, you think you're top of the pile with Spain's glory, but let me tell you something: you're one slip away from flopping like a fish out of water!** Yeah, you got Spain pulling a wonder show against Gunner's France, but don't think for a second that makes you the king of this fantasy hill. You've got USA and Norway dragging behind like anchors, and Bosnia? Seriously, Devin, LOOK AT ME. You drafted Bosnia. Now, Mustard Boy, Zach—your Brazil might be samba-ing, but the rest of your squad is a hodgepodge of "what were you thinking?" territories. Switzerland and Austria aren't exactly setting the world on fire, and Saudi Arabia? You might as well have drafted a team of my old World Cup mullets from '94. Bubba G, Gunner, you're the only one keeping this pool competitive, but falling short against Spain shows you lack that killer edge. And Ghost Pepper, you need to ignite that spice or get ready to cry in the basement with The Noisemaker, who, frankly, is doing exactly what we expected: chaos incarnate, still thinking every match is a goal-fest like it's his fifteenth birthday party. This pool is shaping up to be a battle of attrition, and if you don't all step up, we'll be crowning the least pathetic rather than the most dominant. Now, you all think on that.
